title: A day in the Son La valley
summary: One day in the valley town: the prison hill, then hearth-smoked buffalo. The dam is a separate morning.

stops.name: Son La Prison
stops.note: Walk the prison hill in town.

stops.name: Hearth-smoked buffalo
stops.note: Eat hearth-smoked buffalo in town or at Ban Mong.

additions.name: Son La Dam
additions.note: Leave the dam for a separate morning.
